description.value: Christie's Pub occupies a heritage building on Fort Street in Victoria originally constructed in 1898 as the Christie family home, blending old-world charm with a lively modern bar scene. The pub offers indoor dining and two heated patios—one dog-friendly—alongside a menu of house-made pub favourites, craft beers, wines, and cocktails. It sits in a walkable residential-commercial strip and serves as a welcoming full-service stop for cyclists passing through Victoria's east side.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at christiespub.com confirms this is an active, full-service pub at 1739 Fort St Victoria, BC V8R 1J3 with phone (250) 598-5333. The site explicitly states 'Free wifi provided' and confirms takeout via Skip the Dishes and Door Dash; the menu lists vegetarian options (Black Bean & Avocado Burger, Veggie Benny) and a gluten-free bun substitution. The OSM name 'Christie's Carriage House Pub' does not match the website's consistent branding of 'Christie's Pub', which is flagged as a concern.
